title: aTrain - Accessible Transcription of Interviews
description:
aTrain is a tool for automatically transcribing speech recordings utilizing state-of-the-art machine learning models without uploading any data. It provides a user-friendly interface to OpenAI's Whisper model, ensuring high-quality transcription while preserving data privacy by processing everything locally on the user's device.

This record contains the Windows installer (MSIX). Verify the download against the sha256 checksums published on the corresponding GitHub release.
